text:
elena: Heads-up team 1: KiteBridge POC kickoff. We need to lock prompt inventory, target metrics, and a short runbook for the eval by next Wed. Customer wants a simple cost vs quality tradeoff and a security checklist for hosted vs private. @ajay @kevin @tess

ajay: Can do. Suggested success criteria (first pass):
- macro F1 >= 0.86 on intent classification eval
- hallucination rate <= 6% on factual QA samples
- p99 latency (interactive path) <= 320ms for hosted; for Dedicated target p99 <= 200ms
- cost target: hosted <= $1.10/1k tokens or Dedicated equivalent < $0.75/1k when amortized

kevin: For experiments I propose testing three model configs: redwood-8B (q4), redwood-14B (q4), and redwood-8B (q2) to measure quant impact. We'll capture accuracy, latency, and token cost. If 95p latency exceeds 400ms on any config, we should document fallback policy.

tess: Security items from KiteBridge: EU residency, purpose-limited logging (no raw prompts persisted), KMS-backed keys, IdP SAML metadata for SSO. I'll need example payloads (sanitized) and the minimal data retention policy to fill their vendor security checklist.

chris: Product: add robustness checks. Create a 40-sample adversarial set (typos, code switches, long context) and measure drop in accuracy. Also capture prompt-length sensitivity (0.5x, 1x, 2x) to understand token cost variance.

elena: I'll compile the prompt inventory. Draft baseline intents below; feel free to edit.

```
# baseline prompt inventory (intent -> brief example)
"Extract action items from this support thread." -> extract_actions
"Generate a terse status update for an internal stakeholder." -> status_update
"Rewrite customer message to be more formal and concise." -> rewrite_formal
"Identify if this message contains PII and redaction candidates." -> pii_detection
"Given a sales lead note, recommend next-step playbook." -> sales_play_reco
```

maya: Suggest adding a retention-sensitive intent: "Summarize call transcript without storing verbatim user PII." -> pii_safe_summary

ajay: Eval harness note: we'll produce three datasets: gold labels, paraphrase variations (~25 per intent), and adversarial set. Example run command: 

```
ri-eval run --model redwood-8b-q4 --dataset kitebridge_gold.jsonl --metrics macro_f1,latency,hallucination --concurrency 6
```

kevin: Infra knobs: set BATCH=6, MAX_TOK=1024 for the summary workloads. We'll collect token usage distribution and compute per-1k effective cost. Add an experiment to compare streaming vs non-streaming for status_update intent.

tess: Legal note: NDA + DPA required before we hand over any logs. For Hosted demo we can offer a masking proxy that strips PII before storage; for Private they want on-prem option + HSM/KMS integration.

elena: Proposed action list with owners & due dates:
- elena: full prompt inventory + gold/paraphrase datasets by Tue EOD (200606)
- ajay: cost model + experiment matrix by Wed noon (200607)
- kevin: quant & latency matrix + fallback policy by Wed EOD
- tess: security checklist answers + sanitized payload examples by Fri (200608)
- chris & maya: adversarial set and robustness criteria by Tue

maya: I'll seed the paraphrase generator and push ~25 variants per intent to the dataset repo.

ajay: I'll include a cost sensitivity sheet (tokens per call, avg response size) and run hosted vs dedicated estimates.

kevin: Starting quant runs now; will post a table with accuracy delta q2 vs q4 and latencies.

calendar-bot: Event created: "KiteBridge POC sync" Wed 14:00 PT 1 -> https://cal.link/kitebridge-poc-sync

chris: One more: customer asked for an SLA option. We'll prepare two quotes: Hosted (metered) and Dedicated (1/3/6/12 month commits) with approximate pricing bands.

elena: Great. If no objections I'll kick off the eval on Wed using redwood-8B-q4 and attach preliminary numbers. Please post any blockers here.

maya: No blockers from me. I'll coordinate dataset uploads.

elena: ack 1 thanks everyone, will update thread with datasets and first-pass results.
